services.desc: Join us on our genuine 44′ diesel powered down east commercial lobster boat for a unique lobster tour through historic Boston Harbor. Up to 15 passengers will board the boat at one of our several pick up points in downtown Boston. We also have a comfortable 6 person lobster boat - for smaller groups and families. Your Captain will teach you all about lobsters and the lobster fishing industry (hands-on), and you’ll also learn about the types of sea life that are regularly found in the lobster pots. blurb: Boston Charter Boat offers a large fleet of over 50 boats for rent, accommodating groups from 2 to 600 guests. Guests can choose their boat by group size and enjoy exploring the coast with extraordinary views. The company arranges private charters and events on the water.
